"Built with integrity from the ground up" "Built with integrity from the ground up" What Can We Build For You? At Reformed Outdoor Structures, there's really no limit to what we can build together to create your unique and ideal Outdoor Living Space! These structures below and combinations thereof are our most commonly requested: Overhead Structures Traditional Patio Covers Modern Patio Covers Underfoot Structures Trex Decks Composite Decks Outdoor Living Spaces Outdoor Kitchens Grill Stations Custom Specialties Fences Outdoor Fireplaces Services Have A Look! Take a look to see some of our inspirational Outdoor Living Spaces! From Traditional, Modern, to Contemporary; we can custom Design & Build it! Our Process We Take a Three Phase Approach to Provide You with an Exceptional Experience: Consult 1st: We'll set up a Call, Video Conference, or In-Person consultation for us to meet with you to discuss ideas and concepts for the project. Design 2nd: We'll have our designers put those ideas and concepts into a digital and easy to understand 3D CAD drawing with a detailed plan and quote. Build 3rd: Finally, we'll get to work on building your new outdoor addition with our industry leading quality, efficiency, and craftsmanship. ​ ​ Recently Completed Projects Who We Are Reformed Outdoor Structures LLC is family owned and operated. We provide a professional consulting, designing, and building experience for anyone looking to make a custom addition to the usability and value of the exterior of their home. From single additions such as a Deck, Pergola, Patio Cover, Pavilion, Outdoor Kitchen, or Fence, to entire Backyard Makeovers; with our industry leading experience in Reforming design and building techniques, we enjoy and take pride in what we build for our clients! We are daily dedicated to Top Notch Craftsmanship at Low Affordable Pricing. 100% customer satisfaction is a must for us. Two or more referrals is our goal! Read more Our Mission The Christian Reformation over 500 years ago brought the Church back to the Bible as the Word of God. Fallen, sinful man can only be saved by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone. Among the countless blessings it brought with it is a renewed meaning to the work and calling of believers in Christ. In this vein as a family owned/operated business, our mission is to serve the Lord in our work by providing honest, hard work for the clients we work with. We enjoy our craft and strive to provide the best quality and service to our clients! Read more Building To Last "Built with integrity from the ground up" Our approach to building is to implement the most effective building methods and techniques available today. We are always Reforming to better our services to our clients providing them with the highest quality, longest lasting additions to your home. Where others cut corners, we stress the details. The key to long lasting structures are its parts unseen. We build everything to be exceedingly structurally sound, starting with its foundation.
